caption: The drawing features a rectangular, vertically oriented wooden panel centered on a plain light beige background. The panel has a carved design in light to medium brown shades, creating a relief effect. The carving depicts a symmetrical composition with a large, circular flower at the top center, characterized by radiating petal segments. Below the central flower, a pair of smaller, bud-like shapes emerge, each with curved, textured surfaces. Flowing, leafy scrolls extend outward and upward from the bottom of the panel, filling the space with organic forms, curling tendrils, and stylized leaf shapes. The outer edge of the panel is bordered by a thin, beveled frame. In the bottom right corner of the page, outside the panel, there is a handwritten signature and numbering.
title: Furniture Panel
